title: tehas question --json
description: What tehas question <issue> --json prints, version 1: the question the issue waits on and the choices it offers, each in the words tehas answer takes. host/docs/api.md says what each field means. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. console/tests/answer.rs checks that the command prints the samples beside this file, and test/json_contract_test.sh that they fit it.

id.description: The state store's own number of the question, given in order and never reused: not the id of the comment that asked it, as before 2.0.

comment.description: The id of the comment on the issue that asked the question. Left out when the store has no comment for it; never null.

askedAt.description: When it was asked. Before 2.0 the field was asked_at.

choices.description: Exactly the choices the question offers, in the order it lists them.
